description: Na₅Cu(HO₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and one longer (2.30 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.61 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.80 Å) and one longer (1.83 Å) Cu-O bond length. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Cu atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Cu atom to form corner-sharing ONa₅Cu octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°.
